button.label: Open Markdown...
button.supertip: Converts the .md file with Pandoc and opens it in Word. Save then writes Markdown back.

button.label: Save
button.supertip: Writes the document back to its .md file (the previous version is kept in a BAK folder).

button.label: Export Copy as Markdown...
button.supertip: Writes a Markdown copy of any document without changing how the document itself is saved.

button.label: Save as Word (.docx)...
button.supertip: Detaches the document from its Markdown file and saves it as a normal Word document.
